procedure.new_broad_suppression: Reject newly added inner allow/expect attributes and any item expectation whose span covers unrelated unsafe boundaries.
procedure.reason_quality: Require a concrete ABI, handle, pointer, callback, or operating-system contract; reject generic FFI-only wording.
procedure.safety_invariant: Require adjacent SAFETY documentation for pointer extent, initialization, ownership, lifecycle, thread/apartment, panic/non-unwind, result validation, and cleanup when applicable.
procedure.write_attribution: Compare expected SHA-256 and relevant preimage before every patch; verify intended hunks and record the new hash immediately after each patch.
procedure.stale_expectations: Treat every unfulfilled_lint_expectations diagnostic as blocking and remove or relocate the expectation.
